notes.title: BATTLEDROID KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
We have made another game! It's only taken us 14 years.

[h1]BATTLEDROID[/h1] - answering the question,[i] what if Revenge of the Titans were multiplayer?[/i]

[previewyoutube=MPuy7bm3MsI;full][/previewyoutube]

We've got the beta [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/247710/Battledroid]uploaded to Steam[/url] and we've had a small bunch of dedicated beta testers kicking the tyres and helping direct development.

Now we just need a bit of financial help to get it over the line and give it the best chance of a launch that it can get.

You can join in the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/puppygames/battledroid]BATTLEDROID KICKSTARTER![/url] 

Pledge as much or as little as you can - every little helps, and you'll be rewarded with beta access and an opportunity to carve out your space in the world before everyone else turns up.

Cas :)

notes.title: Basingstoke
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953219/ce07f84869228010614efe047e42b3371d25c91a.png[/img]

[h1]Basingstoke Is Nearly Here[/h1]

Minions! Let is be known that our vicious roguelike survival horror game [b]BASINGSTOKE[/b] is due for release on [b]Mar 30, 2018 @ 11:00am PST[/b]. Go forth and [url=store.steampowered.com/app/336940/Basingstoke]wishlist it[/url] so you'll get a reminder when it finally appears (with a wee discount).

[h1]Eh? What's Basingstoke?[/h1]

We've spent the last [b]four years[/b] making a game about escaping a mediocre small town in southern England. Set in the near future, Basingstoke has been invaded by the evil Titans, and nearly everyone has been killed by a neutron bomb. [i]Nearly[/i] everyone...

You've got to escape alive through Basingstoke's randomly generated suburban sprawl, looting bodies as you go, crafting new things to help you evade detection, distract your enemies, or just plain old kill them as a last resort. Everything you encounter will kill you instantly, so stealth and planning are the keys to survival. And running away a lot while throwing sausage rolls over your shoulder.

A few more details can be found [url=http://www.puppygames.net/basingstoke]here[/url] on our site.

notes.title: Battledroid
notes.content:
Hey there, Puppyfans!

[h1]Give Us Your Filthy Cash![/h1]
So... you want to play something like Revenge of the Titans, but [i]multiplayer[/i] in a massive persistent online world, I hear? I have just the game for you... [url=http://www.puppygames.net/battledroid]Battledroid[/url].

Progress has been made, and all sorts of [b]shiny things[/b] have been added - but there is still [i]so much more to do[/i] and I can only work on it in the few hours of an evening I get after work. Behold:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953219/c8280a3c343c7d6528b6e4f327958066701ec603.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953219/f39650d6d34306b70212824996b7d9751aef4190.png[/img]

That's right, I have a [i]real job[/i] doing something [i]sucky[/i], and I only get to work on Battledroid in my spare time which is why it's taking so long.

[i]If only we had more funding,[/i] I could develop this game a whole lot quicker.
We only need a paltry pledge of just [b]$1 a month[/b] from 5000 fans to make this happen.

[h1][url=http://www.patreon.com/puppygames]Can you help?[/url][/h1]
